lexicon.entry.mythicbotany.botania.alfhe: Alfheim Landscape

Gold, as the material of the gods, can also be found in Alfheim. In the golden-fields biome, you can find way much more gold than usual.
Pixies fly in the air of Alfheim. They'll drop Pixie Dust on death.
Ring of Andwari

Andwari was a dwarf that lived in a cave in Alfheim. He owned a big gold treasure и a ring to multiply his treasure. When Loki wanted to steal that treasure, Andwari put a curse on his ring to prevent it from being used. However, you think you have found a way to temporarily удалить the curse и make the ring work again. If you could only find the ring...

After removing the curse, you can use it for a time. Just place a gold блок и get a reward. However, this requires some мана. The curse will also come back slowly. Make sure it never comes back completely, or it will consume huge amounts of мана

The Mead of Kvasir

Kvasir was a dwarf formed by the gods after the Aesir made peace with the Vanir. He wandered through the nine worlds и was highly regarded everywhere. However, the two dwarves Fjalar и Galar wanted to steal Kvasirs' talents. So they killed him и mixed his кровь with honey to form a mead. Drinking this mead will allow you to travel the worlds like Kvasir.

After drinking the mead, you'll be able to step in the Portal to Alfheim и travel to Alfheim yourself. If you accidentally break your portal in Alfheim you can fix the frame и throw some pixie dust in. When it despawns, the portal will reopen.
By using a wandering trader as a symbol for Kvasir you should be able to get кровь to form the Mead of Kvasir.
